scene.ko: 동물원에서 아이를 잃어버려 직원에게 아이의 생김새를 설명하고, 아이를 찾을 때까지 침착하게 도움을 받는다.

lines.en: Excuse me, I need help. I can't find my son. He was right next to me at the penguin house a minute ago.
lines.ko: 실례합니다, 도와주세요. 아들을 못 찾겠어요. 조금 전까지 펭귄관에서 바로 옆에 있었는데요.
alt: Excuse me, please help me. My son is missing. He was with me at the penguin house a minute ago.

lines.en: Okay, try to stay calm. We'll find him. How old is he, and what is he wearing?
lines.ko: 네, 진정하세요. 저희가 찾아 드릴게요. 아이가 몇 살이고 어떤 옷을 입고 있나요?

lines.en: He's six. He's wearing a yellow raincoat and blue rain boots, and he has a stuffed tiger with him.
lines.ko: 여섯 살이에요. 노란 우비에 파란 장화를 신었고, 호랑이 인형을 들고 있어요.
alt: He's six years old. He has on a yellow raincoat and blue boots, and he's holding a toy tiger.

lines.en: Thank you. What's his name? I'll let all the staff know on the radio right away.
lines.ko: 감사합니다. 이름이 뭐예요? 바로 무전으로 모든 직원에게 알릴게요.

lines.en: His name is Jun. He doesn't speak much English, so he might be too scared to ask anyone for help.
lines.ko: 이름은 준이에요. 영어를 잘 못하니까 겁먹어서 아무한테도 도와 달라고 못 할 수도 있어요.
alt: It's Jun. His English isn't very good, so he may be too scared to ask for help.

lines.en: That's helpful to know. Is there anywhere he really wanted to go? Kids often head to their favorite animal.
lines.ko: 알아 두면 도움이 되겠네요. 아이가 꼭 가고 싶어 한 곳이 있나요? 아이들은 좋아하는 동물한테 가는 경우가 많거든요.

lines.en: Now that you mention it, he kept asking about the tigers all morning.
lines.ko: 그러고 보니 아침 내내 호랑이 얘기를 계속했어요.
alt: Come to think of it, he talked about the tigers all morning.
Actually, he kept asking about the tigers this morning.

lines.en: Good news! A staff member just found a boy in a yellow raincoat at the tiger exhibit. He's safe, and he's still holding his tiger.
lines.ko: 좋은 소식이에요! 방금 직원이 호랑이 전시장에서 노란 우비를 입은 남자아이를 찾았대요. 아이는 무사하고, 호랑이 인형도 그대로 들고 있대요.

lines.en: Oh, what a relief! Could you take me there? I don't want him waiting alone.
lines.ko: 아, 정말 다행이에요! 거기로 데려다주실 수 있어요? 아이 혼자 기다리게 하고 싶지 않아요.
alt: Thank goodness! Can you take me to him? I don't want him to be alone.
Oh, I'm so relieved! Could you show me the way?

lines.en: Of course. Follow me. By the way, many parents write their phone number on their child's arm, just in case.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 따라오세요. 참고로, 혹시 몰라서 아이 팔에 전화번호를 적어 두는 부모님들이 많아요.

expressions.en: He might be too scared to ___.
expressions.note: too + 형용사 + to 동사 = 너무 ~해서 못 하다
상대 말을 듣고 무언가 떠올랐을 때
